findings.evidence: All confirmed consumers in `BaseChange.lean`, `Comap.lean`, and `Transport.lean` rewrite with `PresentationIndex.map_pres_num` or `map_pres_den`; none requires unfolding the body.
findings.fix: Remove `@[expose]` and use `map_pres_num`, `map_pres_den`, and any additional explicit characteristic lemmas needed by consumers.
findings.issue: `PresentationIndex.map` is marked `@[expose]` even though its public projection lemmas provide the required computational interface, leaking proof-field implementation details to downstream modules.

findings.evidence: Their right-hand sides eliminate `PresentationIndex.map`, and the PR repeatedly invokes them manually throughout `BaseChange.lean`, `Comap.lean`, and `Transport.lean`.
findings.fix: Mark both lemmas `@[simp]` so projections of mapped indices normalize through the public API.
findings.issue: The characteristic projection lemmas `map_pres_num` and `map_pres_den` (lines 280 and 285) are normal-form equations but lack `@[simp]`.

summary: `PresentationIndex.map` unnecessarily exposes its implementation, while its projection API also lacks normal-form simplification annotations.
